Class Game

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.server.model.Game
All Implemented Interfaces:
ModelInterface
public class Game extends Object implements ModelInterface
Central domain object representing a single game session.

Game orchestrates the full game lifecycle via an internal State Machine (Game.GameState / Game.BaseState and concrete inner states). It holds the authoritative list of Players, delegates board operations to GameBoard, and broadcasts all observable changes through GameNotifier.

The FSM is started by calling startFSM(). From that point on, players interact exclusively through moveTotem(String, char) and resolveActions(String, List), which are forwarded to the current state.

  • Constructor Details

    • Game

      public Game(String gameID, List<String> nicknames, Map<String,Totem> chosenTotems, long seed)
      Creates a new Game with a seeded random source. Players are created from the provided nickname list using the chosen totems.
      Parameters:
      gameID - unique identifier for this game session
      nicknames - ordered list of player nicknames (determines initial insertion order)
      chosenTotems - mapping from nickname to the totem each player has chosen
      seed - seed for the internal Random, ensuring reproducible shuffles

      public void moveTotem(String nickname, char tileID)
      Moves a player's totem to an offer tile or back to the turn-order tile, depending on the current game state.
      Specified by:
      moveTotem in interface ModelInterface
      Parameters:
      nickname - the player issuing the move
      tileID - the target tile character identifier (e.g. 'A', 'B', or 'T' for turn-order)
      Throws:
      InvalidMoveException - if totem movement is not allowed in the current state
      NotYourTurnException - if it is not this player's turn

    • startFSM

      public void startFSM()
      Starts the FSM by entering the SetUpState, which initializes the board, randomizes the turn order, and immediately transitions into totem placement. Must be called exactly once after the game object is constructed.
      Specified by:

    • enqueueExtraTurn

      public void enqueueExtraTurn(String nickname, int extraUpperPicks, int extraLowerPicks)
      Enqueues an extra turn for the given player. The extra turn is activated at the beginning of the next EndRoundState.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the player who will receive the extra turn
      extraUpperPicks - the number of additional upper-row picks allowed
      extraLowerPicks - the number of additional lower-row picks allowed

      public void triggerTurnOrderExtraFood(Tribu tribu)

    • injectBuildingForTesting

      public void injectBuildingForTesting(String nickname, String cardID)
      FOR TESTING ONLY. Instantly grants a building card to a player, bypassing deck draw, board availability, and food cost requirements. Call after startFSM() has completed setup.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the player to receive the building
      cardID - the building card ID to grant (e.g. "B_020")
